text: UCHealth is a non-profit health system headquartered in Aurora, Colorado, formed from University of Colorado Hospital and Poudre Valley Health System. It has no shareholders and no direct state owner, although it is academically tied to the University of Colorado. The Colorado Rapids front deal is non-profit health money.
short: UCHealth is a non-profit health system headquartered in Aurora, Colorado, formed from University of Colorado Hospital and Poudre Valley Health System.
